title: Squirrel Sightings (Optional) Part b)
body: Alankrita wants to find the best location where she is most likely to find a squirrel. Write a line of code that evaluates to the location with the most squirrel sightings.\n##figure1.gif

figureAlts.figure1.gif: A table of squirrel sightings with columns: Squirrel ID, Location, Day, Month, and Year. Squirrel ID is a unique identification number for each squirrel. Location is the common name of the nearest campus landmark where the squirrel was spotted. Month is the numerical representation of the month when the squirrel was spotted. Day is the day of the month when the squirrel was spotted. Year is the year when the squirrel was spotted. Row 1: 2937, Wheeler Hall, 17, 3, 2024; Row 2: 8421, East Asian Library, 28, 9, 2022; Row 3: 472, Etcheverry Hall, 7, 1, 2024; Row 4: 239, Campbell Hall, 4, 10, 2023; Row 5: 2937, Moffitt Library, 7, 6, 2021.
